facts.P2_fcy_account: Mostly not needed: Monaco uses the euro.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register with the Trade and Industry Registry (RCI); steps not confirmed yet.
facts.L2_tax_id: Monaco doesn't issue tax identification numbers.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: No personal income tax, except for French nationals.
facts.L4_vat_gst: French VAT rules and rates apply (20% standard).
facts.L5_data_protection: A data protection law exists; details not confirmed yet.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: No online consumer protection law recorded in UNCTAD's tracker.

watch_out.text: Selling mainly abroad (over 25% of turnover) can trigger business profit tax.
